Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Benton Leather Swivel Office Chair with Wheels, 28.4"W, Black
Colors: Grey
Materials: Leather
Top-grain leather and bold, eclectic armrests make this swivel office chair a style stand-out. The two-paneled back, firm cushioning and elastic webbing make it durable and comfortable, while the leather shows unique natural markings. 28.4"W x 24.2"D x 41"H Top-grain leather upholstery; wood and metal swivel base; five metal wheels. 360 degree swivel. Sturdy for up to 250 lb capacity. Top-grain leather shows unique markings. Easy assembly in 15 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
